rule: Reuse canonical identities and exact versions. Domain coordinates are independent of JAI execution layers. Recorded validation is not authority or contractual acceptance.

active_roots.client: distinct exact Publication version with audience=client

current_selection.active_claims: Exact scoped Claim versions; must equal publication-root ancestry claims. Unbound or omitted scoped commitments block readiness.
current_selection.active_versions: Explicit draft-only exact versions before publication roots exist; cannot select two versions of one canonical identity.
current_selection.history: Store retains immutable historical entities/relations; current assurance and client export evaluate selected forward-dependency closure. Supersession/review navigation never pulls obsolete claims into current validity.
current_selection.fabric_binding: ExecutionContract data fabric_binding_id/digest resolve through the trusted ledger adapter; text declarations do not establish assurance.
